def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0]); out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    regions=[];seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i][j]==1 and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True;cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ca,cb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=ca<h and 0<=cb<w and inp[ca][cb]==1 and not seen[ca][cb]:
                            seen[ca][cb]=True;q.append((ca,cb))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                cells=set(cells)
                bb={(a,b) for a in range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1) for b in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)}&cells
                out_h=[r[:] for r in inp]
                for a,b in bb: out[a][b]=2
                interior=[(a,b) for a,b in cells if (a,b) not in bb]
                for a,b in interior: out[a][b]=3
                regions.append((out,a-w))  # out is grid with bbox=2, interior=3
    return out
